Class DecodedFrame

java.lang.Object
org.roux.model.DecodedFrame
public class DecodedFrame extends Object
The DecodedFrame is one message copied onto the heap from a stored frame. The object stores the message id, which is the number that locates the frame. The object stores the role byte. The object stores the time in epoch milliseconds. The object stores the token count that was saved with the message. The object stores the message text. ToonCodec builds this object when a caller reads a payload. A null text is stored as an empty string. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#DecodedFrame roux-v1.md

  • Constructor Details

    • DecodedFrame

      public DecodedFrame(long messageId, byte role, long timestampEpochMs, int tokenCount, String text)
      The constructor stores the message id, the role, the time, the token count, and the text. A null text is stored as an empty string.
      Parameters:
      messageId - The message id is the number that locates the frame.
      role - The role is the byte from Role.
      timestampEpochMs - The time is the epoch milliseconds stored with the message.
      tokenCount - The token count is the number stored with the message.
      text - The text is the message body, or an empty string.
